# ============================================================================
# GBOGEB/CODEX — Archive Generation & GitHub Pages Deployment
# Builds asset bundle and deploys visual gallery
# ============================================================================

name: Archive & Deploy

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read
  pages: write
  id-token: write

concurrency:
  group: "pages"
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  build-archive:
    name: Build Asset Bundle
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python 3.11
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pip install pyyaml

      - name: Clean SVGs
        run: |
          python src/svg_cleaner.py --input-dir assets/canonical/ --output-dir assets/compiled/ --prefix gbc

      - name: Build archive bundle
        run: |
          echo "═══ Building gbc_asset_bundle.tar.gz ═══"
          tar -czf gbc_asset_bundle.tar.gz \
            assets/compiled/ \
            config/visual_data.yaml \
            config/knowledge_topology.json \
            config/stakeholder_registry.yaml \
            lineage_manifest.json \
            README.md
          ls -lh gbc_asset_bundle.tar.gz

      - name: Upload bundle artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: gbc-asset-bundle
          path: gbc_asset_bundle.tar.gz
          retention-days: 90

  deploy-gallery:
    name: Deploy Visual Gallery
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: build-archive
    environment:
      name: github-pages
      url: ${{ steps.deployment.outputs.page_url }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python 3.11
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pip install pyyaml

      - name: Clean SVGs for gallery
        run: |
          python src/svg_cleaner.py --input-dir assets/canonical/ --output-dir assets/compiled/ --prefix gbc

      - name: Prepare Pages directory
        run: |
          mkdir -p _site/assets
          cp web/index.html _site/
          cp -r assets/compiled/ _site/assets/compiled/
          cp -r assets/canonical/ _site/assets/canonical/
          cp config/visual_data.yaml _site/
          cp config/knowledge_topology.json _site/
          [ -f lineage_manifest.json ] && cp lineage_manifest.json _site/ || true
          [ -f gbc_asset_bundle.tar.gz ] && cp gbc_asset_bundle.tar.gz _site/ || true

      - name: Upload Pages artifact
        uses: actions/upload-pages-artifact@v3

      - name: Deploy to GitHub Pages
        id: deployment
        uses: actions/deploy-pages@v4
